response.overview: On Christmas Eve in New York City, a desperate new father whose reckless business ambition entangled him with a crime boss. He races to save his kidnapped newborn son. Unknown to him guided by a mysterious old-fashioned stranger who leads him toward saving his son before the night ends. The true beauty is revealed when the mysterious stranger's identity becomes known. A story of hope, faith and a Christmas miracle.
response.title: Nothing Short of A Miracle
